description: Merges WireframeComponentSchema entries from all registered IWireframeSchemaSource implementations. When two sources register the same Type, the one with the higher Priority wins. Registered as a singleton via AddTempoBlazor() or AddWireframeSchemas(). Useful for MCP tools and AI-assisted wireframe generation — exposes a complete catalog of all available components and their property definitions without any Blazor rendering dependency.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: All registered schema sources, injected by DI.

methods.name: GetAll()
methods.description: Returns all registered schemas ordered by Category then DisplayName.

methods.name: GetSchema(string type)
methods.description: Returns the schema for the given component type (case-insensitive), or null if not registered.

methods.name: GetByCategory(string category)
methods.description: Returns all schemas in the given category (case-insensitive).

methods.name: GetCategories()
methods.description: Returns all distinct category names in alphabetical order.

mcpUsage: Inject WireframeSchemaRegistry into an MCP tool handler. Call GetAll() and serialize to JSON to give an LLM a complete component catalog for wireframe generation.
